content.problemStatement:
Write a program to reverse the given array and search an element in the reversed array and then print the searched element's index. If no such element were found print -1.

Note :Print only the first occurrence of search element.
content.inputFormat:
The first line has an integer N denotes the size of the array.

The second line contains N values seperated by space.
content.outputFormat: Print the index of the searched element in the reversed array.

solution.approach: Find index of target element in reversed array.

code.Python3:
import sys
def main():
    toks = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not toks: return
    n = int(toks[0])
    arr = [int(x) for x in toks[1:n+1]]
    target = int(toks[n+1])
    rev = list(reversed(arr))
    print(rev.index(target) if target in rev else -1)
if __name__ == "__main__": main()

solution.editorial: Reverse array and search for target returning 0-based index.
